limitations: One condition compares two disposable Jenkins string credentials using exact authored identities; no general secret support or credential authorization claim.

Canaries are generated inside the isolated controller, never supplied by the user or archived. The observation checks exact plaintext absence in complete bounded build logs, not general masking, encoding, exfiltration or security.
The full unchanged production Jenkinsfile executes with a native credentials environment and one guarded local checkout. Omitted and substituted binding mutants must skip checkout.
Pipeline-wide credential lifetime follows the existing renderer contract; no least-privilege scoping, rotation, external store, cross-job secret transfer or value/state continuity claim.
The disposable controller has no network egress or published host ports. Runtime hosts and observation transport remain trusted; no support or portability promotion.
